title: Breach: Wombgifts and Hiveblood
summary: Juiced Breach maps for Wombgifts and Hiveblood: Breach tablets roll Wombgift level-ups and Hiveblood quantity, Moment of Risk scales Wombgift levels with every map modifier, and Breeding Program picks the Wombgift type.

budget.build_needs: Clears Unstable Breaches with extra rare waves in juiced T15+ maps.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Grows into a Currency item on the Genesis Tree; Breeding Program can favour it.
Grows into an Amulet on the Genesis Tree.

nodes.name: Evolutionary Pressure
nodes.effect: 1% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Monsters, 2% increased Effectiveness of Monsters and 3% increased chance of Monster Modifiers on Rare Monsters, each per Explicit Modifier on the Map

nodes.name: Improved Calibration
nodes.effect: Waystones have 25% more effect of Prefix Modifiers or 25% more effect of Suffix Modifiers when opening Maps

claim.note: Owner's notes pick Doryani for Breach. Our reading: Evolutionary Pressure and Moment of Risk both scale per Explicit Modifier on the Map, and Improved Calibration strengthens waystone mods. Not measured. T3 and T4 are free picks: no Doryani T3/T4 node touches Breach.

steps: Allocate Moment of Risk and Breeding Program (pick the Wombgift type you sell), then the Hiveblood and Wombgift quantity nodes.
Set Doryani: Evolutionary Pressure and Improved Calibration; T3 and T4 are free picks.
Roll waystones for monster rarity, effectiveness and item rarity; more explicit mods feed Moment of Risk.
Slot a Breach Tablet; pick one suffix (Wombgift level-up first, else Hiveblood or Wombgift quantity, else extra Unstable Breach rares) and one prefix (monster effectiveness or item rarity).
Grow Wombgifts on the Genesis Tree with the Hiveblood you collect.
risks: Hiveblood is spent at the Genesis Tree (cap 100,000) and has no market price, so it is not in the basket.
0.5.5 spawns stabilised Unstable Breach rares in waves of 5.
Wombgifts are priced as seeds; what they grow into is random.
